officialEvidence.claim: Node 24 documents node:sqlite as stability 1.2 and exposes DatabaseSync plus backup.
better-sqlite3 13.0.0 is the first N-API release and directly includes prebuilds intended to work across supported Node and Electron versions.
better-sqlite3 13.0.2 is the 2026-07-29 release and embeds SQLite 3.53.4.
Electron requires actual runtime proof for ABI-dependent native modules.

schemaStatements: CREATE TABLE works (work_id TEXT PRIMARY KEY, display_name TEXT NOT NULL)

CREATE TABLE documents (work_id TEXT NOT NULL, document_id TEXT NOT NULL, display_name TEXT NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY (work_id, document_id), FOREIGN KEY (work_id) REFERENCES works(work_id) ON DELETE RESTRICT)

CREATE TABLE revisions (work_id TEXT NOT NULL, document_id TEXT NOT NULL, revision_id TEXT NOT NULL, sequence INTEGER NOT NULL, content_checksum TEXT NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY (work_id, document_id, revision_id), UNIQUE (work_id, document_id, sequence), FOREIGN KEY (work_id, document_id) REFERENCES documents(work_id, document_id) ON DELETE RESTRICT)

writeTransaction.insertDocumentSql: INSERT INTO documents (work_id, document_id, display_name) VALUES (?, ?, ?)
writeTransaction.insertRevisionSql: INSERT INTO revisions (work_id, document_id, revision_id, sequence, content_checksum) VALUES (?, ?, ?, ?, ?)

rollbackTransaction.verificationSql: SELECT work_id FROM works WHERE work_id = ?

foreignKeyRejection.insertDocumentSql: INSERT INTO documents (work_id, document_id, display_name) VALUES (?, ?, ?)
foreignKeyRejection.verificationSql: SELECT work_id, document_id FROM documents WHERE document_id = ?

ledgerVerificationSql: SELECT w.work_id, d.document_id, r.revision_id, r.sequence, r.content_checksum FROM works AS w JOIN documents AS d ON d.work_id = w.work_id JOIN revisions AS r ON r.work_id = d.work_id AND r.document_id = d.document_id ORDER BY w.work_id, d.document_id, r.sequence
